import threading

import pytest


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def session_fixture():
    """Start 5000 idle threads for the duration of the test session."""
    stop_event = threading.Event()
    threads = []

    def idle_worker():
        stop_event.wait()

    for index in range(5000):
        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=idle_worker,
            name=f"idle-thread-{index}",
            daemon=True,
        )
        thread.start()
        threads.append(thread)

    yield threads

    stop_event.set()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join()
